name: Slice-Aware NTN
description: A Docker-based testbed integrating Non-Terrestrial Networks as slice-aware backhaul links in 5G networks, using free5GC and UERANSIM. Published at IEEE LCN 2021.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Pre-built images available on Docker HUB at https://hub.docker.com/r/shynuu/sa-ntn. Deploys 64 containers across scenarios including gNB, UEs, 5G control plane components (AMF, SMF, PCF), and application servers.

eval_notes: Directly relevant for NTN-5G integration evaluation. Agents could configure network slices over satellite backhaul, diagnose QoS issues, and manage slice-aware routing across terrestrial-satellite boundaries.
